name: MP Maps in Zombies Menu
author: Liam-McCormack-Github
description:
The menu mod for the MP Maps in Zombies ports. It adds main menu buttons that launch each ported map without console commands, custom loading screen art and text, and options for boss and special zombies.

It also enables sv_cheats and adds a command listener: set zm_cmd <command>.

This is an early beta. Bug reports: [url=https://github.com/Liam-McCormack-Github/bo2-release-builds]github.com/Liam-McCormack-Github/bo2-release-builds[/url]
